text:
marco: starting a zone-by-zone rollout tonight, US -> EU -> APAC. target window 22:00-02:00 UTC. can we confirm warm pools and soft-pin plan?

deploy-bot: scheduled: release v2.4.1 will start at 2024-04-15T22:00:00Z. regions: us eu apac. canary: 5%. pin-mode: soft-pin (traffic slice).

jen: i ran a quick capacity sweep on the us warm pool — healthy. headroom ~28% at p95 load.

sree: EU warm pool needs one extra GPU node to hit our latency SLO under bursty traffic. recommending +1 g5.xlarge for prewarm.

olivia: noted. adding one EU node now, will take ~6m to register.

kyle: APAC warm pool is low because of a longer thermal cooldown; can we reduce canary to 2% for APAC initially and ramp?

marco: yes, plan: US 5% -> monitor 15m -> 25% -> hold. EU add node then 5% -> 15m -> hold. APAC 2% -> 30m -> 5% -> hold. rollback triggers: latency p95 +50ms vs baseline for 5m OR error rate >2% sustained 3m.

jen: can we add a smoke eval for output-quality regression on the US canary? quick eval harness against key promptset.

deploy-bot: smoke-eval job created: smoke-eval/1712345678-us with promptset "checkout-critical". results pushed to /releases/v2.4.1/evals.

opsbot: NOTE: change window advisory — database maintenance scheduled 23:30-23:45 UTC. recommend not advancing EU->APAC during that 15m.

marco: good catch. we'll pause EU ramp at 23:25 UTC and resume at 23:50.

olivia: EU node added, registered. health checks green.

jen: US canary started. API latency p50=42ms p95=110ms. smoke-eval running.

deploy-bot: canary rollout update: US canary at 5%. pods: 12/12 healthy. logs: no errors in last 5m.

jen: smoke-eval results: pass 98/100, 2 minor formatting diffs (not critical).

marco: thumbs up. advance US to 25% in 5.

deploy-bot: advancing US to 25% now.

kyle: APAC canary started at 2%. initial p95 is 220ms (higher baseline), error rate 0.6%. will keep at 2% during APAC peak until 02:00 local.

sree: EU ramp to 5% proceeding. monitoring p95 and CPU.

opsbot: reminder: rollback playbook pinned at /runbooks/rollbacks/v2.4.1. if triggering automated rollback, ops will get notified and we will pin previous stable (v2.3.7).

marco: decision tree — if US p95 breaches +80ms for 5m -> immediate rollback for US slice and revert routing, then isolate rollout for EU/APAC. if smoke-eval quality fails -> abort rollout and pin.

jen: logging an incident channel if anything crosses thresholds: #incidents-release. I'll post graphs.

deploy-bot: rollout status at 22:43Z: US 25% healthy, EU 5% healthy, APAC 2% stable. next holdpoint 23:00Z for cross-region check.

marco: perfect. keep chatter here for the holdpoint. :thumbsup:
